name: Dome generator
description: A thin concrete shell dome from its diameter and height: spherical or elliptical shell, stem wall, ring beam, framed openings, foam and form, with quantities, a bar count, forces under weight, snow, wind and earthquake, bending, a buckling figure and an IFC file. Metric or feet and inches. Norm values come from spec side add-ons. A licensed engineer must design and check the dome.
author: CadCraft
